system.description:
Against vehicles and spaceships it deals 60 damage at their scale and ignores shields. A hit destroys the target's armour (an Armoured Carapace until repaired); Robots and Drones take double damage. Alien artefact: making it usable by a human takes a Repair check (12, or 8 with 2,000cr and a week). Powered by an Alien Power Cell.

Exploration Supplement
